get.description: The process is up. The load balancer restarts a task that stops answering.
The gateway can serve: its database answers.

message.title: Message
message.description: Our own wording. Never text from PF.

reference.description: The correlation ID, shown to the user so support can find the request.

ApiError.title: ApiError
ApiError.description: The body of every error response, and the payload of `message.failed`.

project_id.description: The project the chat is filed under, if any.

next.description: Null when there are no older conversations.

ConversationPage.title: ConversationPage
ConversationPage.description: Reply to GET /v1/conversations: the visitor's conversations, most recently active first.

Cursor.description: Opaque. Pass it as `before` for the next page.

Feedback.title: Feedback
Feedback.description: Body of PUT /v1/conversations/{id}/messages/{id}/feedback: the visitor's rating of an answer.

FileBlock.title: FileBlock
FileBlock.description:
A file the visitor attached to a question (M10), downloaded from
GET /v1/conversations/{id}/files/{file id}. Also the reply to an upload.

Filing.title: Filing
Filing.description:
Body of PATCH /v1/conversations/{id}, and optionally of POST /v1/conversations: the project a chat is filed
under, or null for none. Signed-in visitors only.

Id.description: Our opaque ID. Never a PF ID.

MarkdownBlock.title: MarkdownBlock
MarkdownBlock.description: Markdown. Tables, code and fenced diagram blocks travel inside it (D9).

feedback.title: Feedback
feedback.description: The visitor's rating of an answer.

pinned.title: Pinned
pinned.description: The visitor pinned this answer to find it again.

next.description: Null when this page starts the conversation.

MessagePage.title: MessagePage
MessagePage.description: Reply to GET /v1/conversations/{id}/messages: a page of messages, oldest first, and the page before it.

question.title: Question
question.description: What the visitor asked, as typed; null if it is not stored.

Pin.title: Pin
Pin.description: A pinned answer, with what was asked and the chat it is in.

PinPage.title: PinPage
PinPage.description: Reply to GET /v1/pins: the visitor's pinned answers, the newest pin first.

updated_at.title: Updated At
updated_at.description: When the project or a chat in it was last active.

Project.title: Project
Project.description: A signed-in visitor's folder of chats.

ProjectPage.title: ProjectPage
ProjectPage.description: Reply to GET /v1/projects: the visitor's projects, most recently active first.

text.title: Text
text.description: What the visitor typed: 1 to 4,000 characters, not only spaces.

client_message_id.description: Chosen by the chat. Sending again with the same ID returns the same reply.

attachments.title: Attachments
attachments.description: Files uploaded to this conversation, sent with the question: at most 5.

SendMessage.title: SendMessage
SendMessage.description: Body of POST /v1/conversations/{id}/messages. The reply streams StreamEvent lines, with `: ping` heartbeats.

Session.title: Session
Session.description: Reply to POST /v1/sessions. The token is opaque to the browser and goes back as `Authorization: Bearer`.

SessionRequest.title: SessionRequest
SessionRequest.description: Body of POST /v1/sessions. A signed-in visitor brings the token the host signed for them; anyone else, null.

TextBlock.title: TextBlock
TextBlock.description: Plain text, shown exactly as written and never interpreted. Used for what the user typed.

UnknownBlock.title: UnknownBlock
UnknownBlock.description: A block type this version does not know, sent by a newer gateway. Shown as its `text`, if it has one.

ai_notice.title: Ai Notice
ai_notice.description: Null means the widget's own wording.

avatar.title: Avatar
avatar.description: The assistant's picture, uploaded through the admin API: the SHA-256 of an image served at /v1/images/{avatar}. The launcher and the chat show it; null shows the chat glyph.

greeting.title: Greeting
greeting.description: A short line shown once beside the closed launcher, such as "Hi, I'm Eva."

attachments_enabled.title: Attachments Enabled
attachments_enabled.description: Visitors may attach doc, docx, pdf, jpg, jpeg and png files to a question.
